title: Daily Market Digest
subtitle: Sunday, August 02, 2026 - Summary of Friday, July 31, 2026 Trading Session

items.headline: U.S. Stocks Rally to End Volatile July, Led by Amazon's Strong Earnings
items.summary: U.S. equities concluded a dynamic July with broad gains on Friday, July 31, 2026, as robust earnings from Amazon.com overshadowed a significant decline in Apple shares. Investor sentiment was sharply divided, focusing on distinct winners and losers from a pivotal week of corporate reports. Rising oil prices, however, fueled ongoing concerns about inflation.

items.headline: Amazon.com ($AMZN)
items.summary: Amazon surged following a significant Q2 earnings beat, driven by accelerating growth in its Amazon Web Services (AWS) segment and stronger-than-expected profitability, indicating positive returns from AI investments.

items.headline: Newell Brands ($NWL)
items.summary: Shares advanced after the consumer products company surpassed Q2 earnings and revenue expectations and provided a significantly raised full-year profit outlook.

items.headline: AXT ($AXTI)
items.summary: AXT soared after reporting Q2 results that exceeded expectations, with revenue increasing 160% year-over-year, driven by strong demand for data center optical connectivity and AI infrastructure.

items.headline: Apple Inc. ($AAPL)
items.summary: Apple dropped sharply after issuing a disappointing forecast for upcoming revenue growth. Concerns were also raised by a lackluster forward sales outlook, rising component costs, and slowing growth in key segments, with AI-driven chip supply constraints impacting its hardware business.

items.headline: Reddit Inc. ($RDDT)
items.summary: Reddit shares cratered with significant trading volume, indicating a strong sell-off during the session.

items.headline: Corteva ($CTVA)
items.summary: Corteva was among the worst performers in the materials sector after its quarterly revenue of $6.38 billion missed consensus estimates of $6.62 billion.

items.headline: Consumer Discretionary Leads, Materials Sector Lags
items.summary: The Consumer Discretionary sector emerged as the top-performing sector on Friday, registering a gain of 6.07%, primarily propelled by Amazon's stellar earnings. Conversely, the Materials sector faced the largest drawdown, declining by 2.71%. Strong Q2 2026 earnings are reinforcing a bullish outlook beyond mega-cap tech, with Information Technology, Energy, and Communication Services sectors showing double-digit revenue growth.

items.headline: Fed Holds Rates Steady Amidst Divided Vote, Treasury Yields Climb
items.summary: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) voted to keep interest rates unchanged at 3.5%-3.75% during its Wednesday meeting, marking the fifth consecutive hold. However, a divided vote, with three members favoring a hike, highlighted ongoing internal debate. Treasury yields climbed on Friday, with the 10-year U.S. Treasury note surpassing 4.7%, as inflation worries persisted in the bond market.

items.headline: U.S. Q2 GDP Slows to 1.5%; Oil Prices Soar Amid Geopolitical Tensions
items.summary: The first estimate for U.S. Q2 2026 GDP showed annualized growth of 1.5%, a slowdown from Q1's 2.1%, yet still indicating moderate expansion driven by resilient consumer spending. Meanwhile, crude oil prices surged, with U.S. crude closing above $85 a barrel, reflecting a 21% rise in July due to escalating conflict between the U.S. and Iran.

items.headline: S&P 500 Q2 Earnings Season Exceeds Expectations
items.summary: More than halfway through the Q2 2026 earnings season, the S&P 500 is reporting remarkably strong results. 86% of companies have reported actual EPS above estimates, with aggregate earnings surprising analysts by 31.4% – the highest earnings surprise magnitude recorded since FactSet began tracking this metric in 2008. Revenue growth also shows strong momentum, currently at 14.1%.

items.headline: AbbVie Announces Strong Q2 Results and Proposed Acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics
items.summary: AbbVie reported excellent second-quarter 2026 financial results, with GAAP diluted EPS of $2.03 and adjusted diluted EPS of $3.65. The pharmaceutical giant also announced a definitive agreement to acquire Apogee Therapeutics, aiming to bolster its immunology leadership.
